caveats: attendees is optional AND readonly; undefined for busy-projection events (content.kind === 'busy') and for Compass-native events with no guests. The badge must handle undefined/empty.

Known unticketed bug: in anonymous IndexedDB (local) mode, any resize/move/edit permanently drops conference/organizer/attendees - so a manual in-app check in local mode may show an empty badge after an interaction. Use a synced account or the demo seed for verification.

test_touchpoints.detail: The existing card test file - 20+ its covering both cards. New badge tests belong here. Uses bun:test (describe/it/expect/mock), @testing-library/react render+screen, @testing-library/jest-dom, a local createEvent(overrides) factory cast `as GridEvent`, and a shared `position` fixture.
Covers the existing RSVP dot rendering; extracting ATTENDEE_STATUS_DOT must keep these green.

conventions_to_honour: Semantic Tailwind tokens only (bg-success/bg-error/bg-warning/bg-text-subtle) - enforced by check-semantic-colors.ts in `bun lint`.
Path aliases @web/* and @core/*; import order enforced by Biome.

Cards are absolutely positioned with overflow-hidden and already reserve bottom-right for EventRepeatIcon (all-day adds pr-3.5 when it shows). A badge must not collide with it, nor with the 4.5px invisible resize handles (top/bottom on timed, left/right on all-day), nor with the 3px calendar accent bar at inset-y-0 left-0.

Compact cards: COMPACT_EVENT_MAX_HEIGHT, MIN_EVENT_HEIGHT_FOR_TIME_LABEL and MIN_EVENT_WIDTH_FOR_TIME_LABEL gate existing chrome (see grid.constants.ts). The badge needs an analogous size gate or it will overflow tiny cards.

Accessibility: follow the EventDetailsSection precedent - decorative dot aria-hidden, real information folded into the card's existing aria-label (built at TimedEventCard.tsx:265 and AllDayEventCard.tsx:139). A prior CMP-105 run's ruling A dropped 'Guest' to a group-level aria-label.
Known pre-existing UI bug in scope-adjacent code: the endDate resize handle is not hit-testable on ~30% of cards (elementFromPoint occlusion). Do not let a new absolutely-positioned badge widen that.
